+def _extract_unit_price(payload: dict) -> float:
+    """Read the unit price from a pricing response.
+
+    The pricing service has published the value under several names across
+    releases ("unit_price", "price", "amount", and the integer-cents
+    "unit_price_cents"/"price_cents" variants).  Accept whichever is present
+    instead of assuming a single key.
+    """
+    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail="malformed pricing response")
+    body = payload
+    inner = payload.get("price")
+    if isinstance(inner, dict):
+        body = inner
+    for key in ("unit_price", "price", "unit_amount", "amount", "value"):
+        value = body.get(key)
+        if isinstance(value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool):
+            return float(value)
+    for key in ("unit_price_cents", "price_cents", "amount_cents"):
+        value = body.get(key)
+        if isinstance(value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool):
+            return float(value) / 100.0
+    raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail="malformed pricing response")
+
+
